_comment: Replay fixture for the KRAS G12C oncology query. garsorasib is intentionally omitted (asset recall < 100%); the final claim cites a non-retrieved source and is dropped by the guard.

assets.mechanism: Covalent (irreversible) inhibitor trapping GDP-bound KRAS G12C via Cys12
assets.latest_readout: CodeBreaK 200 (NCT04303780): improved PFS vs docetaxel, no significant OS benefit (Lancet 2023); CodeBreaK 100 ORR ~37% (NEJM 2021).

assets.mechanism: Covalent (irreversible) inhibitor of GDP-bound KRAS G12C; CNS-penetrant
assets.indication: NSCLC (2L+); colorectal cancer (accelerated approval with cetuximab)
assets.latest_readout: KRYSTAL-12 (NCT04685135): PFS vs docetaxel; KRYSTAL-1 NSCLC ORR ~43% (NEJM 2022); CRC + cetuximab (NEJM 2023).

assets.indication: NSCLC and colorectal cancer; adjuvant program
assets.latest_readout: Single-agent phase 1: ORR 53.4% in NSCLC (NEJM 2023, PMID 37611121); advancing to phase 3 incl. adjuvant.
KontRASt-01 confirmed ORR ~41.7%; advanced to phase 3 KontRASt-02 vs docetaxel (NCT05132075).

assets.mechanism: Oral non-covalent RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor (cyclophilin A) targeting the active GTP-bound state
assets.latest_readout: Positive phase 3 in previously treated RAS-mutant metastatic PDAC (NEJM 2026, PMID 42090791); RASolve 301 NSCLC ongoing.

assets.mechanism: Non-covalent selective KRAS G12D inhibitor (switch-II pocket)
assets.indication: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and other G12D solid tumors
assets.latest_readout: First selective G12D inhibitor in the clinic; lead phase 1/2 (NCT05737706) terminated.

narrative_claims.text: Two covalent KRAS G12C inhibitors are FDA-approved: sotorasib (Amgen) and adagrasib (Mirati/BMS), both for previously treated KRAS G12C NSCLC.
In confirmatory phase 3, CodeBreaK 200 and KRYSTAL-12 each improved PFS versus docetaxel but neither demonstrated a clear overall-survival benefit.
Divarasib (Genentech/Roche) reported a best-in-class ~53% objective response rate in KRAS G12C NSCLC in a phase 1 study published in NEJM in 2023.
Daraxonrasib (RMC-6236), an oral pan-RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor, delivered a positive phase 3 readout in previously treated RAS-mutant metastatic pancreatic cancer in 2026.
MRTX1133 was the first selective non-covalent KRAS G12D inhibitor in the clinic, though its lead phase 1 trial was terminated.
Opnurasib (Novartis, JDQ443) advanced to the phase 3 KontRASt-02 trial versus docetaxel in KRAS G12C NSCLC.
Glecirasib (Jacobio) showed roughly 48% ORR in KRAS G12C NSCLC in a phase 2b trial (Nature Medicine 2025).
KRAS (ENSG00000133703) is most strongly associated with pancreatic, colorectal and lung carcinomas in Open Targets.
Sotorasib is also approved for KRAS G12D-mutant pancreatic cancer.
